claims: The Artemis II rocket is the Space Launch System (SLS).
The Space Launch System (SLS) is built by a consortium of major aerospace companies led by NASA.
The main core stage of the Space Launch System (SLS) is built by Boeing.
The twin solid rocket boosters of the Space Launch System (SLS) are produced by Northrop Grumman.
The Orion capsule is built by Lockheed Martin.
The SLS Core Stage is built by Boeing.
The Solid Rocket Boosters are produced by Northrop Grumman.
The RS-25 Engines are built by Aerojet Rocketdyne.
Aerojet Rocketdyne is now part of L3Harris.
The Orion Crew Module is built by Lockheed Martin.
The European Service Module (ESM) is built by Airbus on behalf of ESA.
The SLS is designed to be the most powerful rocket in the world.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight to take humans around the Moon in over 50 years.
